name: Mazemind Tome
oracle_text:
{T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)
{2}, {T}, Put a page counter on this artifact: Draw a card.
When there are four or more page counters on this artifact, exile it. If you do, you gain 4 life.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that puts N counters of a named kind (here one 'page' counter) on the source permanent, paid at activation alongside {T} and mana
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_keys has remove_counters and remove_counters_from_among but nothing that adds counters; the only cost that adds counters is loyalty, which is hard-wired to the 'loyalty' kind. Writing add_counters as an effect moves the payment to resolution, which the packet notes forbid

needs.what: a state trigger (603.8) that fires when the source has at least N counters of a kind ('four or more page counters on this artifact') and does not retrigger while its ability is on the stack, with effects exile-self then 'if you do' gain 4 life
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has counter_placed, which fires on placement rather than on the state holding; a counter_placed trigger with a counters_on >= 4 condition would also re-trigger on every later counter and depends on cost-placed counters raising the event, which no current cost does
